test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. 

(8, 18, 32)
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(8, 18, 32)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5756ada8f0d322c585f7dac204a17166c2564d7712845f8199f8d755a62cce.png] 

__
 
• **5, 7 are consecutive prime numbers added.**

Similarly,

1) (35, 52, 80) → 35 is not divisible by 2

2) (46, 68, 102)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7b3de47b6602b2e2e447ea58359971a0dee29c497a39bb623c936f701b300d1.png] 

Here 11 and 17 are not consecutive prime numbers.

3) (52, 78, 128)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd3bf680e4e613657ca3703c1f5e2dbe6e93afc5736f7b30b7d56316fea3d712.png] 

**4) (50, 72, 98)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d4aa2aa8f8e9bb33c09f691caeb9bba6ae5ee72d0aeafb2e77bd111b105342.png] 

 
• **11, 13 are consecutive prime numbers added.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(50, 72, 98)".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is :-

**(First number + third number) / 2 - 2 = Second number**

(8, 18, 32)

8 + 32 = 40 / 2 = 20 - 2 = 18

Similarly, 

**Option 4: (50, 72, 98)**

**50 + 98 = 148 / 2 = 74 - 2 = 72**

Hence, the correct answer is "(50, 72, 98)".
